candidates.title: TokenSelect: Efficient Long-Context Inference and Length Extrapolation for LLMs via Dynamic Token-Level KV Cache Selection
candidates.reason: Training-free dynamic token-level KV selection with a dedicated paged dot-product kernel, reporting large attention and end-to-end speedups.

candidates.title: SwiftKV: Fast Prefill-Optimized Inference with Knowledge-Preserving Model Transformation
candidates.reason: Prefill-optimized model transformation that skips later-layer prompt computation while preserving generation quality and supports KV compression.

candidates.title: SpecVLM: Enhancing Speculative Decoding of Video LLMs via Verifier-Guided Token Pruning
candidates.reason: Training-free speculative-decoding framework for video LLMs using verifier-guided video-token pruning to reduce memory/compute and accelerate decoding.

candidates.title: PLD+: Accelerating LLM Inference by Leveraging Language Model Artifacts
candidates.reason: Tuning-free inference acceleration leveraging prompt overlap and inference artifacts such as attention/hidden states without extra model compute.
